up: Return the exact activity values for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649957. Include the canonical SMILES for each compound. Do not impose any restrictions on activity types, units, or relations; return all associated activity records.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649957'
